department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India (run in Tamil Nadu by the Agriculture - Farmers Welfare Department)
benefit: Your farm soil is tested and you get a Soil Health Card. In Tamil Nadu, the soil test for the card costs a subsidised Rs 110.
how_to_apply: You can ask for a Soil Health Card on the national Soil Health Card portal. It also shows the nearest soil testing lab.
where_to_apply: Village level: Assistant Agricultural Officer or Assistant Horticultural Officer. Block level: Deputy Agricultural Officer or Agricultural Officer.
